title: b01 with an explicit writing instruction (same model, seeds, sampling and cap)
purpose: Test the cause-analysis H1: b01's zero fact-qualified result may come from a state-view prompt that never asks for prose. Only the user-turn instruction changes; the shared case, model, seeds, sampling, cap and rubric stay identical.

model.family: Qwen2.5 instruct base (actual config/weight hashes recorded by the runner)

template.system: You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.
template.instruction: 请把下面的已结算状态写成一段中文小说正文，180 到 260 字。必须写出【本回合变化】里的移动、时间推进、物品变化和人物变化；可以写细微动作、对白和视角人物的感受，但不得新增人物、物品、地点、事件、往事或承诺；不要逐条复述状态，不要写标题或列表。
template.whyThisInstruction: Uses only the settled change vocabulary and the allowed polish boundary from 01's rubric; it adds no fact and does not reveal the reference. It is the minimal prompt change that tests H1.

gate: If v2 has zero fact-qualified candidates, stop N expansion and take the evidence to 02/06; do not relax the rubric. If v2 has >=2 fact-qualified non-homogeneous candidates, prepare b02 with this template under a new preregistration and then run the paired N=1/2/4 comparison.

resource.device: one HPC GPU; fp16 on V100 is acceptable (b01 measured it), bf16 on 4090 if available
